identity.operation: Enable saved-comment handling during string parsing.
identity.condition: The harness constructs the parser with flags 0 while the saved-comment mode uses UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.
identity.capability: Reach the supported comment-saving behavior through the parser setup.
identity.consequence: Inputs cannot exercise saved-comment handling through that setup.

requirement: Make supported saved-comment behavior reachable through string parsing.

assessment.necessity_reason: Saved comments are a supported mode of string parsing. A finite input such as "# comment\nx=1;" can reach comment saving when UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS is set. The fixed harness always constructs the parser with flags 0 and has no later configuration step, so input bytes cannot enable the mode or provide an equivalent route.

before.requirement: String parsing must be able to save and attach input comments when the parser is constructed with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.
before.reason: The flag, guarded saving path, and attachment path existed before the change. The harness passes flags 0.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Comment input calls the saving helper only when the flag is set.
Parser construction copies the supplied flags and creates comment storage only in saved-comment mode.

after.requirement: String parsing must be able to save and attach input comments when the parser is constructed with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.
after.reason: The guarded saving path remains, and the selected changes alter pending-comment handling and cleanup. The old harness still passes flags 0.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Comment input still calls the saving helper only when the flag is set.
Parser construction still gates comment storage on the supplied flags.
The second selected change adds cleanup for a saved comment left pending at parser destruction.

assessment.comparison_reason: On both source versions, the same fixed call to ucl_parser_new(0) prevents saved-comment mode. The changes to pending-comment handling do not change that harness constraint.

necessity_evidence.reason: Saved-comment mode is supported during string parsing, but the old harness always constructs the parser with flags 0. The same coverage gap is preexisting: both source versions require UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS to save comments.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: Input bytes "# comment\nx=1;" with parser setup UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS would save the comment. The actual target passes 0, so those same bytes cannot enable saving.

scope_contract.reason: The target parses strings through a configurable parser. The public flag defines saving comments in that parser context, and the changed state-machine code handles pending saved comments.

feasible_trigger.reason: A finite UCL string beginning with a comment can enter comment skipping. With UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS set, that path calls ucl_save_comment; the target accepts nonempty bytes but fixes the constructor argument at 0.

evidence.dependency_reason: The UCL state machine invokes comment skipping at initialization.

observable_consequence.reason: The saved-comment behavior cannot occur: saving is flag guarded, and construction creates comment storage only when that flag is set. The target passes 0 for every input.

evidence.dependency_reason: Constructor setup gates comment storage on the same flag.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: Natural comment bytes can reach the skip helper, but cannot bypass its flag guard. The complete target entry has no subsequent flag configuration or other parsing sequence; its only parser construction passes 0.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser retains the constructor flags and conditionally creates comment storage.

identity_preserved.reason: The same tuple—string parsing with saved-comment mode blocked by ucl_parser_new(0)—applies before and after. Both versions define the flag and guard saving with it; the after changes affect pending-comment handling and cleanup without changing that setup blocker.

evidence.dependency_reason: Before-source comment saving has the same flag guard.
After-source comment saving retains that guard.
The second change cleans up a pending saved comment; it does not alter the parser setup.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Parser construction gates comment storage on the supplied flags.
The cleanup change concerns a pending saved comment.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Save and attach comments while parsing a UCL string.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The old harness calls ucl_parser_new(0) for every nonempty input.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Comment input is skipped without entering the guarded saving path.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None in the complete target entry; input bytes cannot change the constructor flags.
